skills.name: skill-creator
skills.purpose: Create, edit and improve Agent Skills, run evals and benchmarks on them, and optimize descriptions for reliable triggering.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when the user wants to create or improve a skill; Python for the eval scripts.
skills.evidence: Official Anthropic; skills.sh 397K installs; aitmpl #1 skill (16.8K downloads); Smithery verified; in all major awesome lists

skills.name: brainstorming
skills.purpose: Socratic design session before any creative/feature work: explores intent, constraints and alternatives, then writes a validated design/spec.
skills.how_to_use: Auto-triggers before building features (superpowers plugin) or invoke /brainstorming.
skills.evidence: Superpowers 294k stars; skills.sh 384K installs; aitmpl 10.2K downloads; on mcpservers.org; top pick in 2026 roundups

skills.name: using-superpowers
skills.purpose: Bootstrap skill for the Superpowers plugin: establishes that the agent must look for and invoke relevant skills before any response, and how to find them.
skills.how_to_use: Loaded at session start by the Superpowers plugin; the entry point that makes the other superpowers skills (brainstorming, writing-plans, etc.) fire reliably.
skills.evidence: obra/superpowers 294k stars; skills.sh 258k installs; mcpservers.org listed; known gap
skills.notes: Most useful alongside the rest of Superpowers; subagents are told to ignore it.

skills.name: writing-plans
skills.purpose: Turns a spec into a bite-sized, test-first implementation plan with exact files, code and verification steps for an engineer with zero context.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when you have requirements for a multi-step task, before touching code.
skills.evidence: skills.sh 266.5K installs; aitmpl 1.6K downloads; skills.sh Hot list this week

skills.name: subagent-driven-development
skills.purpose: Executes a plan by dispatching a fresh subagent per task with two-stage review (spec compliance, then code quality) between tasks.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when executing implementation plans with independent tasks in Claude Code.
skills.evidence: skills.sh 220.3K installs

skills.name: caveman
skills.purpose: Terse 'caveman' response mode that cuts filler and token usage while keeping every technical fact.
skills.how_to_use: Invoke /caveman or say 'be brief'/'less tokens'; stays on until 'stop caveman'. Repo also ships caveman-commit, caveman-compress and safe-refactor.
skills.evidence: Repo created Apr 2026, 109k stars; skills.sh 554K installs, trending #99 (caveman-commit/-learn/safe-refactor also trending)

skills.name: find-skills
skills.purpose: Helps the agent discover and install relevant skills from the open skills ecosystem when the user asks 'is there a skill for X'.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on capability-discovery questions; uses the `npx skills` CLI.
skills.evidence: Most-installed skill on skills.sh (3.7M); claudemarketplaces top skill; skills.sh trending #9 (Oct 2026)

skills.name: grilling
skills.purpose: The actual interview engine behind grill-me: maps a plan as a design tree and asks the user frontier questions in numbered rounds with recommended answers until shared understanding.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'grill me' and similar; grill-me and grill-with-docs are thin wrappers that call this skill, so install it alongside them.
skills.evidence: mattpocock/skills 275k stars; skills.sh 821k installs
skills.notes: Existing entry grill-me (7 lines) just calls 'grilling'; without this skill grill-me does nothing.

skills.name: handoff
skills.purpose: Compacts the current conversation into a handoff document so a fresh agent session can pick up the work without losing context.
skills.how_to_use: Invoke manually (/handoff, model-invocation disabled) with what the next session is for; writes to the OS temp dir. Sibling claude-handoff launches a background agent instead.
skills.evidence: mattpocock/skills 275k stars; skills.sh 907k installs (top-10 overall)
skills.notes: Short SKILL.md (16 lines) but complete; manual-only.

skills.name: grill-me
skills.purpose: Has Claude relentlessly interview you about a plan or design until every branch of the decision tree is resolved.
skills.how_to_use: Invoke explicitly ('grill me') before implementing a plan.
skills.evidence: mattpocock/skills 275k stars; skills.sh 1.3M installs; claudemarketplaces top-3; skills.sh trending #20
skills.notes: Very short prompt-style skill (a few lines); value is the pattern, not depth. Related: grill-with-docs (1.1M).

skills.name: writing-skills
skills.purpose: Applies TDD to skill authoring: pressure-test scenarios with subagents, watch baseline fail, write the skill, close loopholes, verify before deploying.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when creating or editing skills.
skills.evidence: skills.sh 204.6K installs

skills.name: executing-plans
skills.purpose: Executes a written plan inline in batches with review checkpoints when subagents aren't used.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when implementing a plan yourself in the current session.
skills.evidence: skills.sh 227.8K installs; skills.sh Hot list this week

skills.name: writing-for-agents
skills.purpose: Principles for writing documents agents read: skills, AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md (concision, structure, triggers).
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when creating/editing skills or CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md.
skills.evidence: skills.sh 351K installs; on mcpservers.org

skills.name: planning-with-files
skills.purpose: Manus-style persistent planning: keeps task_plan.md, findings.md and progress.md on disk with hooks so long tasks survive /clear, compaction and crashes.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on multi-step tasks or /plan; hooks require installing as a plugin.
skills.evidence: 27k stars; skills.sh 45.2K (+ translated variants); aitmpl 470 downloads; on mcpservers.org; recommended in 2026 roundups

skills.name: codex-delegate
skills.purpose: Delegates a coding task to the OpenAI Codex CLI as a background implementer, then reviews its diff and lands it, keeping Claude as reviewer.
skills.how_to_use: Say 'have Codex do X' / 'delegate this to Codex'; needs the Codex CLI. Sibling skills cover opencode, cursor, aider, copilot and more.
skills.evidence: Repo created Jun 14 2026, 2.3k stars; skills.sh 6.6K installs; delegate-setup/opencode-delegate etc. on Hot list

skills.name: claudex-loop
skills.purpose: Hardens a plan with independent Claude/Codex adversarial review (recon, interrogate, review), then optionally builds and cross-inspects it.
skills.how_to_use: Say 'claudex this plan' or /claudex-loop on non-trivial plans; needs both Claude Code and Codex CLI.
skills.evidence: Repo created Jun 5 2026, 2.7k stars (repo-level license NOASSERTION; MIT LICENSE file in repo)

skills.name: context-engineering
skills.purpose: Optimizes an agent's context setup: rules files, what to load per task, session hygiene and recovery when output quality degrades.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers at session start, on task switches, or when quality drops.
skills.evidence: addyosmani/agent-skills 100k stars; skills.sh 44.7K installs; in VoltAgent list

skills.name: strategic-compact
skills.purpose: Suggests manual /compact at logical task-phase boundaries (with a hook) instead of arbitrary auto-compaction, preserving key context.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when nearing context limits; optional PreToolUse hook counts tool calls.
skills.evidence: everything-claude-code (ECC) 271k stars; skills.sh 3.7K; listed in hesreallyhim

skills.name: continuous-learning-v2
skills.purpose: Observes sessions via hooks, records atomic 'instincts' with confidence scores, and evolves them into skills/commands/agents; project-scoped.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when capturing lessons; requires installing its hooks.
skills.evidence: ECC 271k stars

skills.name: mem-search
skills.purpose: Searches claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database ('did we already solve this?') with progressive-disclosure retrieval.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on questions about past sessions; requires the claude-mem plugin (local worker + SQLite/Chroma).
skills.evidence: claude-mem 95k stars; skills.sh 8.5K; in VoltAgent list

skills.name: self-learning
skills.purpose: Captures a hard-won 'golden path' from the current session (debugging fix, deploy workflow, env facts) as a reusable Agent Skill so future sessions start knowing it.
skills.how_to_use: Use right after non-trivial debugging or workflow discovery, or ask to save it as a skill.
skills.evidence: Repo created Jun 28 2026, ~1k stars; skills.sh 800 installs

skills.name: claude-md-improver
skills.purpose: Audits all CLAUDE.md files in a repo against quality criteria, reports scores, and makes targeted updates.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'audit/improve CLAUDE.md'; install claude-md-management plugin.
skills.evidence: Official Anthropic plugin; skills.sh 11.5K installs

skills.name: claude-automation-recommender
skills.purpose: Analyzes a codebase and recommends Claude Code automations: hooks, subagents, skills, plugins and MCP servers.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'optimize my Claude Code setup'; install claude-code-setup plugin.
skills.evidence: Official Anthropic plugin; skills.sh 8.0K installs

skills.name: hook-development
skills.purpose: Comprehensive guide to Claude Code hooks: events (PreToolUse, Stop, SubagentStop...), prompt-based hooks, validation scripts and ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'create a hook / block dangerous commands'; part of plugin-dev plugin.
skills.evidence: Official Anthropic; skills.sh 6.4K (+13.9K under anthropics/claude-code copy); aitmpl 270 downloads

skills.name: agent-development
skills.purpose: How to write Claude Code subagents: frontmatter, descriptions that trigger, tools, system prompts and examples.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'create a subagent'; part of plugin-dev plugin (sibling skills: skill-development, command-development, plugin-structure).
skills.evidence: Official Anthropic; skills.sh 6.7K (+18.9K under anthropics/claude-code copy); aitmpl 2.5K downloads

skills.name: context-optimization
skills.purpose: Context-efficiency techniques: budgeting, observation masking, KV-cache-friendly prefixes, partitioning and retrieval scoping.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when token cost or context limits hurt quality; pairs with context-fundamentals/-compression/-degradation.
skills.evidence: 18k-star collection; listed in VoltAgent, hesreallyhim, ComposioHQ

skills.name: git-guardrails-claude-code
skills.purpose: Sets up Claude Code PreToolUse hooks that block destructive git commands (push, reset --hard, clean, branch -D).
skills.how_to_use: Invoke when you want git safety rails in Claude Code; writes to settings/hooks.
skills.evidence: skills.sh 423K installs; mattpocock 275k stars
